supporting_quotes.exact: In computer science, an array is a data structure consisting of a collection of elements (values or variables), of the same memory size, each identified by at least one array index or key, the collection of which may be a tuple, known as an index tuple.

observations.subject: array
observations.object: data structure of same-memory-size elements (values or variables), each identified by at least one index/key, whose collection may be an index tuple

claims.rationale: claim 为引文 evidence-c4b9fe95c672[0,253) 的完整逐句忠实转述："In computer science" 对应"在计算机科学中"（[0,21)），"a data structure consisting of a collection of elements (values or variables), of the same memory size" 对应"由同内存大小的元素（值或变量）组成的数据结构"，"each identified by at least one array index or key" 对应"每个元素由至少一个数组下标（索引/键）标识"，"the collection of which may be a tuple, known as an index tuple"（[189,253)）对应"多个下标可组成索引元组"，无增删、无弱化。

supporting_quotes.exact: In general, an array is a mutable and linear collection of elements with the same data type. An array is stored such that the position (memory address) of each element can be computed from its index tuple by a mathematical formula. The simplest type of data structure is a linear array, also called a one-dimensional array.

observations.subject: array
observations.object: mutable linear collection of same-data-type elements; element address computed from index tuple by formula; simplest data structure is linear (one-dimensional) array

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-48aee0cfd4dd[0,323) 逐句对应 claim 三项："In general, an array is a mutable and linear collection of elements with the same data type" 对应"同数据类型的可变线性集合"；"position (memory address) of each element can be computed from its index tuple by a mathematical formula" 对应"元素的内存地址可由下标元组经数学公式计算得到"；"The simplest type of data structure is a linear array, also called a one-dimensional array"（[232,323)）对应"最简单的数据结构是线性数组（一维数组）"。无修饰或弱化。

supporting_quotes.exact: Arrays are useful mostly because the element indices can be computed at run time.
For that reason, the elements of an array data structure are required to have the same size and should use the same data representation.

observations.subject: arrays
observations.object: element indices can be computed at run time

observations.subject: elements of an array
observations.object: same size and same data representation, for that reason

claims.rationale: claim 两段分别由两条引文支持且彼此相连：引文 evidence-3a0f8a1c609d[0,81)（"Arrays are useful mostly because the element indices can be computed at run time"）完整对应"数组有用主要因为元素下标可在运行时计算"；引文 evidence-966acca3186e[0,136)（"For that reason, the elements of an array data structure are required to have the same size and should use the same data representation"）的"required to have the same size and should use the same data representation"对应"必须同尺寸、使用同一种数据表示"，且"For that reason"与 claim 的"因此"构成同一因果链。两条引文同源（wiki-array-cs），无互相冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: In systems which use processor cache or virtual memory, scanning an array is much faster if successive elements are stored in consecutive positions in memory, rather than sparsely scattered. This is known as spatial locality, which is a type of locality of reference.

observations.subject: scanning an array
observations.object: successive elements stored in consecutive positions vs sparsely scattered (spatial locality, a type of locality of reference)

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-158a9b77e84c[0,267) 与 claim 逐项同构："In systems which use processor cache or virtual memory" 对应"在使用处理器缓存或虚拟内存的系统中"；"scanning an array is much faster if successive elements are stored in consecutive positions in memory, rather than sparsely scattered" 对应"相继元素连续存储时数组的扫描比稀疏散布快得多"；"This is known as spatial locality, which is a type of locality of reference" 对应"这就是空间局部性，是引用局部性的一种"。无增删。

supporting_quotes.exact: Many algorithms that use multidimensional arrays will scan them in a predictable order. A programmer (or a sophisticated compiler) may use this information to choose between row- or column-major layout for each array.
For example, when computing the product A·B of two matrices, it would be best to have A stored in row-major order, and B in column-major order.

observations.subject: many algorithms using multidimensional arrays
observations.predicate: scan in predictable order; programmer/compiler may choose
observations.object: row- or column-major layout per array

observations.subject: matrix product A·B
observations.object: A in row-major order, B in column-major order

claims.rationale: claim 一般陈述由引文 evidence-4ae1136a3f28[0,217) 支持："will scan them in a predictable order" 对应"按可预测顺序扫描"，"A programmer (or a sophisticated compiler) may use this information to choose between row- or column-major layout for each array" 对应"程序员（或编译器）可据此选择行主序或列主序布局"；举例由引文 evidence-45144fe6c9df[0,143) 支持："when computing the product A·B of two matrices, it would be best to have A stored in row-major order, and B in column-major order" 对应"计算矩阵乘积 A·B 时，A 以行主序、B 以列主序存储最佳"。两条引文同源、互补不冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: Random Access : i-th item can be accessed in O(1) Time as we have the base address and every item or reference is of same size.

observations.subject: i-th item
observations.object: O(1) time, given base address and same-size item or reference

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-74c5ebb3931e[0,127) 与 claim 逐词对应："Random Access" 对应"随机访问"；"i-th item can be accessed in O(1) Time as we have the base address and every item or reference is of same size" 的"base address" 对应"基址"、"every item or reference is of same size" 对应"每个元素/引用同尺寸"、"O(1) Time" 对应"O(1) 时间"。无遗漏、无强化。

supporting_quotes.exact: Cache Friendliness : Since items / references are stored at contiguous locations, we get the advantage of locality of reference.

observations.subject: items / references
observations.object: advantage of locality of reference (cache friendliness)

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-74db51a83add[0,128) 完整支持 claim："Cache Friendliness" 对应"缓存友好"；"items / references are stored at contiguous locations" 对应"元素/引用存储在连续位置"；"we get the advantage of locality of reference" 对应"带来引用局部性优势"。无增删。

supporting_quotes.exact: Arrays are used to build other data structures like Stack Queue, Deque, Graph, Hash Table, etc.

observations.subject: arrays
observations.object: other data structures: Stack, Queue, Deque, Graph, Hash Table, etc.

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-2a1b432e458b[0,95) 与 claim 完全等义："Arrays are used to build other data structures" 对应"数组被用来构建其他数据结构"，"Stack Queue, Deque, Graph, Hash Table, etc." 对应"栈、队列、双端队列、图、哈希表等"（源文标点省略不影响语义）。

supporting_quotes.exact: An array is not useful in places where we have operations like insert in the middle, delete from middle and search in a unsorted data.

observations.subject: array
observations.object: insert in the middle, delete from middle, search in unsorted data

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-49d49a2a0411[0,134) 逐项支持 claim："insert in the middle" 对应"中间插入"，"delete from middle" 对应"中间删除"，"search in a unsorted data" 对应"无序数据查找"，"An array is not useful in places where we have operations like" 对应"这类操作场景下，数组并不适用"。无增删、无弱化。
